sections.title: Is it open or closed?
sections.content: nyitva ("open") and zárva ("closed") describe whether a place is currently accessible, always together with van/vannak. Add the -tól/-től ... -ig pattern you already know to give exact hours: kilenctől ötig nyitva van ("it's open from nine to five").

sections.title: Open and closed
rows: it's open from nine to five

items.spanish: A múzeum kilenctől ötig nyitva van.
items.english: The museum is open from nine to five.
The exhibition is closed on Mondays.

sections.content: nyitva and zárva never change form, no matter the subject or how many things you're describing: a bolt nyitva van, a boltok is nyitva vannak — only van/vannak changes, nyitva and zárva stay exactly as they are.
